What this tower covers

Blockchain & Digital Trust delivers distributed-ledger programs where a shared, verifiable record has economic value: enterprise DLT networks for multi-party workflows, asset tokenization, smart contract engineering and audit, provenance and traceability, decentralized identity with verifiable credentials, and on-chain analytics for compliance. We are deliberately institution-grade — permissioned networks, key-management discipline, and regulator-readable audit trails.

Why this tower, why now

Tokenized collateral, digital bonds, and e-money pilots have crossed from whitepaper to production at tier-one institutions, while supply chain regulation (EU Deforestation Regulation, Digital Product Passports) makes provenance a compliance requirement rather than a marketing story. The technology matured exactly as the regulatory pull arrived.

blocks.x: Engineering standards & stack

items: permissioned DLT
Shared ledgers with known counterparties and governed writes — DLT where it earns its keep.
on-chain/off-chain split
What must be tamper-evident goes on ledger; the bulk stays off it, linked and provable.
W3C Verifiable Credentials
Credentials that verify cryptographically without phoning home to a vendor.
HSM key ceremonies
Key generation and rotation performed under ceremony, with the evidence auditors require.

blocks.x: Operational telemetry

items: audit evidence prep
Evidence gathered continuously during the period, so the audit opens prepared instead of panicked.
settlement cycle time
Settlement elapsed time measured end to end, with each hand-off timed separately.
reconciliation breaks
Breaks counted at source per cycle, with aging reported — none carried past the quarter unexplained.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.

How a delivery runs

Delivery on Blockchain & Digital Trust is sequenced so the measurement always precedes the build: two weeks of baseline before the pilot, a scheduled gate before any scale-out, and a fortnightly reading against the signed number.
